name: Differential Vertex Sampling with MIS
definition: A method to estimate the gradient of the loss with respect to scene parameters by importance sampling an intermediate vertex on the path to be the differential vertex, using Multiple Importance Sampling (MIS) to combine this with standard BRDF sampling.
summary: Differential Vertex Sampling with MIS estimates gradients by importance sampling an intermediate vertex, reducing variance for specular materials through Multiple Importance Sampling.
